answer: Admission proof-of-work puzzles at the vault: each new identity must solve a unique puzzle before its key is admitted, bound to prior state to block reuse. The signal is puzzle difficulty auto-tuned so admission cost tracks real scarcity, roughly $12 of compute per slot. A 1,000-identity farm burns ~12,000 CPU-hours ($12k) before earning anything, and the harbor rejects precomputed solutions via freshness nonces. Cost scales linearly per identity while a single honest node pays once, so farming collapses before profitability.
